title: A graph that fits
description:
Squeeze thousands of samples into a graph a few hundred pixels wide without losing spikes.

```
10,000 frame times into 200 columns
each column: min and max of 50 samples
spike of 80 ms at sample 7,321 still visible in column 146
```
hints: Column `i` covers samples from `i * n / width` to `(i + 1) * n / width` (lesson 14.04).
Taking only every 50th sample would very likely miss the spike; min and max never do.
requirements: Split the samples into equal groups, one per column, and keep each group's minimum and maximum.
Draw each column as a line from min to max (here: print the values).
Handle sample counts that do not divide evenly.
stretch: Show the average as a third line.
